attempts.summary: On node1, added persistent fstab entries mounting /tmp and /dev/shm as tmpfs with noexec,nosuid,nodev, applied them live, verified enforcement (execution blocked on both), then performed the mandatory single-node restart: captured pre-restart boot_id and mount state, rebooted node1, polled until reachable, confirmed boot_id changed, and re-verified both mounts persisted with the correct options and still block execution after reboot.
